site.name: Qualiacology
site.role: Psychopharmacology researcher, NAMI co-facilitator, and the artist behind Doopliss.
site.thesis: Studying what it feels like to be alive
site.thesisDeck: Psychopharmacology, browser worlds, music, and a 3,000-person community built to learn, help, and connect.
site.description: Psychopharmacology, strange little browser games, murder pop, and a 3,000-person community built to learn, help, and connect. By Alexander Duncan Guitar.

games.title: No Moon
games.alt: A moon-headed traveler in a crimson coat beneath a fractured night sky
games.summary: They warned you about the Moon. You didn’t listen.
games.metaDescription: No Moon is a fast browser twin-stick roguelike about moon-headed Passengers descending through sealed rooms beneath a missing sky.
games.controls: WASD or arrows + mouse · twin-thumb touch

games.title: Rally
games.alt: A round magenta rival mid-swing on a sunset court, the ball arcing overhead
games.summary: The swing is the shot, and the music only lives while the ball's in the air. Climb five rivals across one summer to a finale you play instead of win.
games.metaDescription: Rally is a mouse-only tennis duel where the swing is the shot and the music only lives while the ball does.
games.controls: Mouse only · click to toss, swing through the ball

games.title: Duskfall
games.alt: A rifle raised toward a horde massing in a golden pine forest
games.summary: Hold the golden-hour treeline against waves of the dead — smooth gunplay, arcade scoring.
games.metaDescription: A realistic golden-hour outdoor horde survival FPS built with Three.js, with smooth gunplay, arcade scoring, and detailed animated enemies.
games.controls: WASD + mouse · full touch controls

games.title: THE EATEN PATH
games.alt: A moonlit forest path closing between twisted trees, watched by eyes in the trunks and recorded on VHS
games.summary: Every path you take eats itself. Walk forward through an infinite nighttime forest while the route seals behind you, the camcorder keeps recording, and the trees watch.
games.metaDescription: THE EATEN PATH is a first-person horror walk through an infinite nighttime forest where every route seals behind you.
games.controls: WASD + mouse · two-thumb touch · Shift to hurry · headphones recommended

games.title: EVENSONG
games.alt: A gold flame and a pale flame joined by a glowing thread across dark strings
games.summary: Five souls are stuck one note from rest, and you are the second voice. Hold the mouse to sing, find the interval each of them needs, and when the choir holds its last chord, the only way to end it is to let go.
games.metaDescription: EVENSONG is a browser game sung in real counterpoint: five stuck souls, a looping ground bass, and an ending that asks you to stop playing.
games.controls: Mouse or touch · hold to sing · release to rest

games.title: Rocket Shoes
games.alt: A round white runner in an orange-striped sweater grinding a neon rail above a city
games.summary: Rocket boots, glowing rails, an endless neon city — never touch the brakes.
games.metaDescription: Rocket Shoes is a browser arcade game: grind the rails, dash the rooftops of an endless neon city, and never touch the brakes.
games.controls: Keyboard + mouse · gamepad · two-thumb touch

games.title: PARTY ANIMAL
games.alt: A neon piñata swinging through party guests on a glossy dance floor
games.summary: You're the piñata, and the piñata fights back. Five party games, a boss made of cake, and two ways to leave when it's over.
games.metaDescription: PARTY ANIMAL is a top-down browser brawler: you're the piñata, the party wants a swing, and the piñata fights back.
games.controls: WASD + mouse · two-thumb touch · click swing · Space dash

games.title: Vesperbane
games.alt: A crimson-cloaked hunter mid-leap between gothic spires under an eclipsed moon
games.summary: Sprint, slash, wall-kick, and dash through a gothic platformer built for speed and blood-red momentum, across two nights.
games.metaDescription: Vesperbane is a fast gothic action platformer: sprint, slash, wall-kick, dash, and ring the bell before the night eats you.
games.controls: WASD or arrows · touch on mobile · rebindable

games.title: Galaxy Sandbox
games.alt: A luminous spiral galaxy warping around a blazing golden perturber
games.summary: Drop perturber masses into a living spiral galaxy and watch wakes shear into little cosmic bruises.
games.metaDescription: Galaxy Sandbox is a restricted N-body browser toy: drop perturber masses into a spiral galaxy and watch the wakes shear away.
games.controls: Drag to launch · right-drag or two fingers to pan · scroll or pinch to zoom

games.title: POCKET SUN
games.alt: A tiny glowing sun curving through a neon gravity playground with black voids and colored orbit trails
games.summary: Pull a tiny living sun through an endless musical gravity playground. Make full orbits, skim the black voids, clear dares, and turn every collision into music.
games.metaDescription: POCKET SUN is an endless one-finger musical gravity toy for phones and desktop browsers.
games.controls: Hold to pull · tap to pulse · mouse or touch

games.title: Uninvited
games.alt: A figure outside a dark house, facing a lit doorway and the silhouette at the top of the stairs
games.summary: The house at the edge of town has been dark for years — but tonight something moves in it. A short first-person horror walk to the last room at the top of the stairs, and an ending you won't see coming.
games.metaDescription: Uninvited is a short first-person horror walk through a dark house, up the stairs, and into the last room.
games.controls: WASD + mouse · dual-thumb mobile controls

games.title: Skyshard
games.alt: A lone figure on a ledge facing floating islands ringed around a fracture in the sky
games.summary: Five small lands under one strange sky — and every boss you beat teaches your body a new move.
games.metaDescription: Skyshard is an open-world FPS with five lands, strange doors, and the things that wait behind them.
games.controls: WASD + mouse · two-thumb touch · click to fire

games.title: Marrow
games.alt: A lantern-carrying figure on a black wooded path toward a distant house
games.summary: A black wood, a haunted house, a graveyard chapel — and something that paces you through all three. Headphones on.
games.metaDescription: Marrow is first-person horror in three acts: a black wood, a haunted house, and a graveyard chapel.
games.controls: WASD + mouse · floating dual sticks on mobile

games.title: Behind You
games.alt: A figure in a red-lit corridor casting the shadow of something not human
games.summary: Hold your nerve in the dark and outlast the things closing in from every side. Every run is a race against your best time — last long enough and you've Held Hell.
games.metaDescription: Behind You is a first-person survival horror game in the browser: hold your nerve in the dark and outlast the things closing in from every side.
games.controls: Desktop only · WASD + mouse

games.title: Still
games.alt: A small figure stopped on descending concrete landings under amber light
games.summary: Five floors down, one rule each: freeze when the lights flicker, move only while it breathes. Headphones required.
games.metaDescription: Still is a house, and what is under it. Headphones. Alone. In the dark.
games.controls: WASD + mouse

games.title: Glide
games.alt: A flying squirrel gliding between colossal sunlit trunks
games.summary: Drift through an endless, sun-dappled forest as a tiny flying squirrel.
games.metaDescription: Glide is a wordless flying-squirrel forest toy from Qualiacology.
games.controls: WASD + mouse

games.title: Pasta Mortale
games.alt: A spaghetti weapon raised in a pasta cathedral flooded with marinara
games.summary: The gun, the enemies, the cathedral, and the flood rising to drown you are all wet spaghetti. Fight to the grand altar, cook the three-phase Noodlemancer, and climb out before the sauce reaches your mouth.
games.metaDescription: Pasta Mortale is a cinematic first-person shooter set in a living gothic basilica built from wet spaghetti, marinara, and bad table manners.
games.controls: WASD move · mouse aim · click fire · F punch

games.title: DUET
games.alt: Two cyan lights on interlocking rings at the center of a vast spiral of rose bullets
games.summary: One partner, no words, and a meter that only fills while you fly close enough to die. Graze the rose lace to warm the room and raise the song; in the last movement you dance your own recorded path, and the only way it resolves is to stay close.
games.metaDescription: DUET is a browser bullet-dance: a wordless duel with one partner where grazing enemy fire is the only way to raise the meter that runs the whole game.
games.controls: WASD/arrows or mouse · Shift focus · Z fire · X bomb

games.title: AFTERGLOW
games.alt: A cyan diamond ship in a dark violet neon arena, ringed by magenta enemies and drifting bullets
games.summary: One arena, waves that keep arriving, and a dash with invincibility frames — so you go through the danger instead of around it. Every level-up offers three boons out of twenty and they stack into a build. Every fifth wave, the Warden turns up.
games.metaDescription: AFTERGLOW is a browser twin-stick survival roguelite — one neon arena, escalating waves, and a dash you learn to live inside.
games.controls: WASD/arrows move · mouse aims and auto-fires · Space or Shift dash · P pause

games.title: FINALE
games.alt: A night city skyline under a sky full of cyan and magenta firework petals
games.summary: Every enemy is a firework shell, and every shell opens a fuse window before it fires. Kill one while the ring is lit and the volley it was about to launch blooms in your colour instead, opening other fuses as it travels. Miss the window and that same volley comes at you.
games.metaDescription: FINALE is a browser bullet hell about beating a firework to its own explosion — kill a shell in its fuse window and its volley blooms in your colour.
games.controls: WASD/arrows or mouse fly · Shift focus · E flare dash · Space bomb · no fire button, the gun is always on

games.title: ECHO//SAINT
games.alt: A small white ship trailing a dashed cyan thread through dense neon bullet patterns on a dark violet field
games.summary: Your ship fires on its own; what you actually do is draw. Hold Closure and a thread trails behind you, release it and the shape seals — every bullet caught inside is deleted and comes back as yours. Small tight loops through the thickest fire pay best, which is the whole problem.
games.metaDescription: ECHO//SAINT is a browser bullet hell where you draw closed shapes around enemy fire and it comes back as your own.
games.controls: WASD/arrows move · hold Space draw · Shift break · Esc pause · mouse, touch and gamepad supported

games.title: CINDERBLOOM
games.alt: A dark ash basin on an alien world lit by a warm sun and a cool companion star, embers rising through haze
games.summary: A survey on a planet that has been burning for a billion years. Ammunition comes out of the things you kill — rounds eject from the wound and home in on you — so the fight funds itself. Every mesh, texture and sound is generated at boot; nothing is loaded from disk.
games.metaDescription: CINDERBLOOM is a browser first-person shooter on an alien fire world where the ammunition comes out of the things you kill.
games.controls: WASD move · mouse look · LMB fire · RMB aim · Shift sprint · R reload · V melee · gamepad supported

games.title: VANTA//9
games.alt: A first-person view down a pale ridge into a dark alien city of black spires under a mauve and teal sky
games.summary: The planet started transmitting in the voices of dead pilots. Three anchors hold the signal up, and you go down there on foot with a rifle to take them apart — then survive whatever answers.
games.metaDescription: VANTA//9 is a browser first-person shooter: descend into a low-poly alien city, sever three Choir Anchors, and survive the last note.
games.controls: WASD move · mouse look · LMB fire · RMB aim · Shift sprint · Space jump · Ctrl slide · R reload

games.title: AFTERPARTY AT THE END OF THE WORLD
games.alt: A neon low-rise city skyline under a violet and pink sky, a broadcast tower ahead and white light closing from behind
games.summary: Sunrise is deleting the city from behind you, so you run right. Eight people are stranded along the route, and every one you stop for adds an instrument to the soundtrack and a move to your kit at the same time. What you get at the end is a record made out of who you stopped for.
games.metaDescription: AFTERPARTY AT THE END OF THE WORLD is a browser platformer about outrunning the sunrise and rescuing the people who made the night worth it.
games.controls: A/D or arrows move · Space jump · Shift dash · S stomp · X blast · gamepad and touch supported

games.title: EVERYBODY LEAVES IN 4/4
games.alt: A cream gig-poster screen printed in tomato red and cobalt blue, the title set in huge condensed capitals
games.summary: Twelve minutes before the 6:05 train and one song left with the band you are leaving. You cannot make anything yourself — every phrase they throw at you is either something you play back at them or a floor tile. Whichever meter fills first is what gets recorded about that person, and it stays recorded.
games.metaDescription: EVERYBODY LEAVES IN 4/4 is a browser action platformer: one last song with your old band, where everything you use is something they threw at you.
games.controls: A/D or arrows move · Space jump · Shift dash · K catch · J play · gamepad and touch supported

games.title: THE DEAD KEEP PLAYING
games.alt: A teal-lit side-view stage inside a thick cream border with a hot-pink offset shadow
games.summary: Every take lasts thirty-four seconds. However it ends — the timer, a death, or you calling it — that run comes back as a ghost that runs and shoots alongside you, and you can stack six of them. The rooms are built so that one body cannot finish them.
games.metaDescription: THE DEAD KEEP PLAYING is a browser platformer where every failed run comes back as a teammate — a one-player co-op built out of your own ghosts.
games.controls: A/D or arrows move · W or Space double jump · X fire · Shift dash · R commit take · gamepad and touch supported

games.title: UNSAY IT
games.alt: A top-down paper-cut town in dark plum, a yellow balloon tagged LIGHT beside a grey shutter tagged HEAVY
games.summary: Every adjective in town exists exactly once, stuck to exactly one thing. You peel a word off something and put it on something else, and it takes its physics and its behaviour with it — pulling LIGHT off the balloon to float a shutter open leaves the balloon HEAVY. Nothing is ever created or destroyed, so every solution is a trade.
games.metaDescription: UNSAY IT is a browser action-adventure where every adjective exists exactly once — peel a word off one thing and stick it on another, and live with the trade.
games.controls: WASD/arrows move · Space dash · J shove · E peel and stick · Q switch word · touch supported

games.title: GOODFIRE
games.alt: A painterly top-down mountain of stippled conifers and grass with a small fire-lookout tower near the centre
games.summary: One mountain, one fire season, one warden on foot. You cut line with a McLeod, light backburns, and sometimes give ground on purpose. There is no fail state — a fire that overruns you becomes scar, and the scars are what make October survivable. Perfect suppression is what arms the mountain.
games.metaDescription: GOODFIRE is a browser wildfire simulation across one season on one mountain, where the ground you fail to hold is what saves you later.
games.controls: WASD move · hold LMB cut line · RMB drip torch · Space stomp · X give ground · G airtanker · M tower view

games.title: Goodnight, Little Gods
games.alt: A dark blue night orchard on a circular plain, a violet glowing well at the centre ringed by pink, cyan and amber light
games.summary: Nine small gods are loose in a night orchard and you have until morning. Pick a colour, sing on the beat, and give each one what it actually wants — some only answer while you are still, some only while you are moving, one only when you are alone. Then walk it home to the well.
games.metaDescription: Goodnight, Little Gods is a short browser rhythm game about singing nine small creatures home before morning.
games.controls: WASD/arrows move · click, Space or E sing · Shift dash · 1 2 3 pick colour · touch supported

games.title: THE LAG
games.alt: A fog-choked corridor of tall mirrored panels lit by one warm lantern, with an answering glow deep in the glass
games.summary: Every wall in the maze is a mirror, and the only way to tell a real corridor from a reflection is your own lantern coming back at you. It comes back about half a second late, and the gap keeps growing. The way out is the one mirror that does not lag.
games.metaDescription: THE LAG is a browser first-person horror game in a maze of mirrors where your reflection runs half a second behind — and keeps closing.
games.controls: WASD/arrows move · mouse look · hold RMB raise lantern · F flare · Shift shutter · E use

games.title: FETCH
games.alt: A moonlit forest path between dark trunks, seen over a pale skull carried at the chest
games.summary: You wake up holding a skull you cannot get rid of. Thrown, it zips straight back — it is the key, the weapon, the only light, and the last thing you want in your hands. The bedroom door is locked from the inside, and the way out is down.
games.metaDescription: FETCH is a browser first-person horror game about a cursed skull that always comes back — key, weapon and lamp through a locked house, a graveyard, and a forest that seals behind you.
games.controls: WASD move · mouse look · hold LMB charge throw · tap RMB or E call it back · Shift run · Space jump · E use

albums.title: Ask Anyone
albums.summary: Pop, pop-punk, and emo — some lyrical dissonance and some truth. The one where the hooks aren’t covering for anybody.

albums.title: Anthropic-Omorphizing
albums.summary: The machine-heart record. Love, loneliness, and large language models — written with the thing it’s about. Fifteen tracks that survived a release, a suspension, and a homecoming; no computers anywhere in the lyrics. The machine stays in the furniture.

albums.title: Summer People
albums.summary: A Doopliss album: sunlit hooks with something wrong under the deck chairs. Summer shimmer, social rot, and a grin that knows exactly where the bodies are sunscreened.

albums.title: Immortalized
albums.summary: The one where redemption was never on the table and the songs are the receipt. He doesn’t repent — he gets remembered. Lacquered into permanence by the same glossy hooks that should have buried him.

albums.title: Hate Fuck Hotline
albums.summary: A feral dispatch from the Doopliss emergency broadcast system. Dial in, regret it later, and don’t pretend you weren’t warned by the title.

albums.title: Pretty Guilty
albums.summary: The one where the verdict was never in question but the sentencing keeps getting delayed. Gorgeous on the surface, rotting underneath, and completely okay with it.

albums.title: Bite Marks & Bubblegum
albums.alt: Bite Marks and Bubblegum album cover
albums.summary: The one that smiles with perfect lipstick while the floor drops out underneath you. Glossy hooks, bruised undertones, and the exact second attraction starts looking like self-destruction.

albums.title: Death Threats & Makeup Sex
albums.alt: Death Threats and Makeup Sex album cover
albums.summary: The big one. Twenty-eight tracks of the entire toxic cycle on repeat — the fight, the fuck, the apology, the amnesia, the relapse. The album that proves love and destruction share a zip code.

albums.title: Cherry Lipstick (And Other Red Flags)
albums.alt: Cherry Lipstick and Other Red Flags album cover
albums.summary: A glittering field guide to attraction, denial, and knowing better about five seconds too late. Romantic comedy energy with a switchblade hidden somewhere in the purse.

albums.title: Thick Thighs, Sweet Lies
albums.alt: Thick Thighs, Sweet Lies album cover
albums.summary: The candy-apple one. Body heat, bad decisions, and compliments you should have read the fine print on. Every sweet thing on this record is load-bearing.
